name: LANDFORM4-reach-short
old: site: Object.freeze({ reach: 40, per: 3, most: 124, grid: 8 }),
new: site: Object.freeze({ reach: 24, per: 3, most: 124, grid: 8 }),

name: LANDFORM4-reach-past-the-neighbour
old: site: Object.freeze({ reach: 40, per: 3, most: 124, grid: 8 }),
new: site: Object.freeze({ reach: 40, per: 3, most: 160, grid: 8 }),

name: LANDFORM4-near-misses-a-neighbour-site
old: const near = around.filter((s) => s.x1 + s.reach > ox && s.x0 - s.reach < ox + span && s.y1 + s.reach > oy && s.y0 - s.reach < oy + span);
new: const near = around.filter((s) => s.x1 > ox && s.x0 - s.reach < ox + span && s.y1 + s.reach > oy && s.y0 - s.reach < oy + span);

name: LANDFORM4-level-off-the-pixel
old: const ox = sx * span, oy = (MAP_H - sy) * span;
new: const ox = sx * span, oy = sy * span;

name: LANDFORM4-site-rect-y-flipped
old: const ox = qx * span, oy = (MAP_H - qy) * span;
new: const ox = qx * span, oy = (MAP_H - qy - 1) * span;

name: LANDFORM4-worker-drops-the-sites
old: if (m.t === 'landform-tables') { sites = m.sites ?? null; climates = m.climates ?? null; return; }

name: LANDFORM4-worker-grid-unpulled
old: const { positions, normals, bed } = restrideGrid({ ...m, woods, roads, sites, beyond, climates });
new: const { positions, normals, bed } = restrideGrid({ ...m, woods, roads, beyond, climates });
note: BAY-LEFT-GROUND: re-aimed by content - the kernels carry the sites past the Bay (D1).

name: LANDFORM4-client-keeps-them-to-itself
old: this._worker.postMessage({ t: 'landform-tables', sites: s, climates: c }, [s, c].filter(Boolean).map((a) => a.buffer));

name: LANDFORM5-coast-too-short
old: hills: Object.freeze({ uplandAt: 700, coast: 1.25, region: 2400, warp: 80, warpScale: 520, scales: Object.freeze([300, 125, 50]), weights: Object.freeze([1, 0.36, 0.1]) }),
new: hills: Object.freeze({ uplandAt: 700, coast: 0.8, region: 2400, warp: 80, warpScale: 520, scales: Object.freeze([300, 125, 50]), weights: Object.freeze([1, 0.36, 0.1]) }),

name: LANDFORM5-no-valley
old: if (valleys.length) hh = carve(gx, gy, hh, deepOut[0]);
new: if (!valleys) hh = carve(gx, gy, hh, deepOut[0]);

name: LANDFORM5-unclamped
old: return saturate((shapeRaw(land.shape, wx, wy, gx, gy, rock, land) - norm[0]) * norm[1]);
new: return (shapeRaw(land.shape, wx, wy, gx, gy, rock, land) - norm[0]) * norm[1] * 1.6;

name: LANDFORM5-road-ignores-the-hills
old: prof[k] = macro > LANDFORM_KNEE ? landAt(sox + lx, soy + ly, macro, macro, low, cliff ? cliff(lx, ly) : 1, around) : macro;
new: prof[k] = macro > 1e9 ? landAt(sox + lx, soy + ly, macro, macro, low, cliff ? cliff(lx, ly) : 1, around) : macro;
